# Saved pages (fixtures)

Real responses saved on 12 Nov 2026 with the ProcureFind User-Agent, used by the tests and by
practice mode (`SUPPLIER_SOURCE=fixtures`). Nothing here is made up.

| Folder | What |
| --- | --- |
| `network_options/`, `ctc_solutions/` | WooCommerce Store API search results (JSON) |
| `optace/` | Optace home page (embedded product list) and one product page |
| `osm/` | Nominatim lookup for "Nairobi" and the Overpass result for IT, electronics and telecom shops and offices in Nairobi. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL |
| `ppra/` | PPRA debarred firms page |
| `sites/<host>/` | Home pages of suppliers found on OpenStreetMap. `meta.json` records a redirect or error status seen at the time. Hosts with no folder didn't respond |
